verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Three routine rewritings, no change of content. (i) The Lean slot radius satisfies r^2 = L_s (`PrimaryCovarianceBounds.slotRadius_sq`, line 173), so its `r` is the paper's √L_s and `lowerMassConstant a B * r ≤ mass ≤ A²√(π/(2b))·r` is exactly c√L_s ≤ ∫ψ²x² ≤ C√L_s with explicit constants. (ii) The integrals are over ℝ, not [0, L_s]; they agree because ψ vanishes off Icc (r^2/6) (5r^2/6) (`PulseBounds.cutoff_zero`). (iii) The second bound is stated as centeredMoment ψ x (r²/2) ≤ A²·firstGaussianMoment(2b)·r², i.e. ∫|v − L_s/2|ψ²x² ≤ C·L_s; dividing by L_s > 0 gives the paper's ∫ (|v−L_s/2|/L_s) ψ²x² ≤ C. The paper's own justification (substitute w = (v − L_s/2)/√L_s, reduce to ∫e^{-cw²} and ∫|w|e^{-cw²}) is the same route the Lean takes, through `integral_gaussian_scaled` and `firstGaussianMoment`.
